panels.description: Mera leads Alex, Ada and B11 through an underground archive lined with physical and digital records. Keep upper shelves clear.
Mera selects records marked surveillance, financial restriction, public liability and travel restriction. Keep upper records clear.
Adrian's record shrinks as warning markers accumulate beside Alex's debt record. Keep upper displays clear.
A help-request log fills with refusals while Mera stands beside the display. Keep upper log clear.

items.text:
SURVEILLANCE ACTIVE.
FINANCIAL RESTRICTION.
PUBLIC LIABILITY.
TRAVEL RESTRICTION.

items.speaker: MERA
items.text: People stopped helping when the record became more dangerous than the man.
